description: This file defines an abstract class for business events related to savings account transactions within the Fineract project. It extends a generic business event class and specifies a category and an aggregate root ID getter.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing business events for savings account transactions, categorized as 'Savings'.

methods.name: SavingsAccountTransactionBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific SavingsAccountTransaction value.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the event, fixed as 'Savings'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the savings account associated with the transaction.
